steps: Anonymous /studio-lab at 1440x900, layout L32: demo video at 0, სრული მიქსი on music at 7, Soft impact on SFX at 4.
Real click ($B click) on the music Volume fader. The value moves to 0.5 with one Volume entry, and focus is now on the fader. Using element.focus() gives the same result.
Real click on the Soft impact clip header. The clip is now selected, but document.activeElement is still 'Volume — მუსიკა'.
Variant: after focusing the fader, real click on the empty SFX lane body, then the clip, then Delete. Focus still stays on the fader.

Order matters: the dispatched order (real clip click, then focus() the fader, then Delete) passes. The reverse order (fader first, then a real click on a clip or lane, then Delete) fails. This is a spec gap found by real interaction.
bugs.expected: Clicking a clip or the lane body moves the edit context to the timeline, so Delete deletes the selected clip and leaves a gap with one entry (SRW-24; task §0 says Delete on a clip or the lane body is unchanged). The fader guard should apply only while the user is actually working the fader.
bugs.actual: Nothing happens: no deletion, no history entry, no status text. The clip stays selected. Delete keeps doing nothing until the user moves focus to some focusable non-range element. Cause by code reading: ArrangementClip.beginGesture calls event.preventDefault() on pointerdown (l.228), which stops the browser moving focus, and the lane body has tabIndex -1. The new isRangeInputTarget guard then sees the stale focused range. Before round 32 the same sequence deleted the clip (that was the C-R31-02 path). The new guard turns 'fader key edits the timeline' into 'Delete silently dead after any fader use'. Regression scope: for Volume, Master and Zoom the fader→clip→Delete sequence used to delete the clip and is now dead. For Pan it was already dead before round 32 (the stopPropagation of deviation 1), so Pan is unchanged-dead. Pan shows the same focus retention (dk.txt row 6: focus stayed on Pan after a real clip click).
bugs.evidence: tmp/studio-real-loop/c-round-32/runs/dk-focus-retention.txt (A = body-focus control deletes; B, C, D = fader focus kept, Delete no-op), runs/dk.txt row 'selected clip' (focus Pan after a real click), runs/bc-pid1-realclick.txt (focus stays on Pan after a real lane-body click), shots/dk-volume-after-delete.png
